## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION, Growth/Momentum style; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (Top 5 from 4 sectors). Confirmation: strong 1W leadership in Materials/Real Estate/Industrials while many large-cap Tech names show short‑term RECOVERY, consistent with money rotating.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Real Estate lead: CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY; Materials lead: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY; Technology strength concentrated in pockets: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND; Energy under pressure this week (trend exhaustion across majors): CVX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) CORRECTION, PSX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.98%) CORRECTION; Communication showing weakest internal momentum among defensives: TMUS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY; INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY; CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY; BA (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND; UL (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -19.72%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -7.58% | 1M: -15.38%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND; CSCO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -1.76%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high‑beta consumer names and select cyclicals.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY, BA (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple mega‑caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) are in RECOVERY, which tempers conviction and warrants watching for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech is mixed with a RECOVERY pattern among megacaps: AAPL (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -7.83%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +5.29% | 1M: -2.36%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -13.89%) RECOVERY; pockets of true strength: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND. Sector participation shows internal rotation even as Tech contributes to breadth.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials showing mixed internals: JPM (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) RECOVERY while Visa (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND; overall sector 1W positive and helping support the ROTATION.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare modestly bid with several RECOVERYs: JNJ (1W: +1.59% | 1M: -0.92%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -4.30%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY and PFE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND — defensive names providing stabilization.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals and select growth/momentum names showing confirmed strength (INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY). Reduce exposure to weak Consumer Discretionary and structurally challenged large caps (NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -11.17%) BELOW TREND); treat megacap RECOVERIES as tactical until 1M confirms.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -11.17%) BELOW TREND, UL (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -19.72%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +3.07%) and Real Estate (1W: +3.94%) for rotation flows; Industrials (1W: +1.48%) for momentum follow‑through.  
BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.14%) showing TREND EXHAUSTION dynamics; Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.47%) where downside is concentrated.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch INTC sustaining ABOVE TREND to signal broader Tech participation; AAPL/MSFT re‑establishing 1M gains would convert RECOVERY into durable uptrend; NVDA holding recent 1W gains is needed to avoid short‑term reversal risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMD (+55): CIQ partnership headline; price (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price strength.  
(Other high‑sentiment names in the feed include PLD/EMR/SHOP but AMD is the clearest SP100 news/price confirmation this week.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BA (-55): safety headlines; price (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) RECOVERY — bearish headlines diverging from near‑term price strength (distribution risk).  
ADBE (-55): negative AI commoditization concern; monitor for follow‑through given limited 1W momentum.  
NKE (-50): multiple price target cuts; price (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming material downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Growth/Momentum style; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).  
INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND are showing the clearest relative strength; NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY is notable for momentum.  
Key risk is major divergence as several mega‑cap Tech names sit in RECOVERY while headlines on BA/ADBE create distribution signals — watch for 1M confirmation before enlarging core positions.
